verdict.rationale: Jan lets users connect to remote frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax and others, and switch freely between local and cloud models, so a user can run large models without downloading them. However, this is integration with third-party providers, not a Jan-hosted cloud tier for offloading the same models. missing for 10: a first-party hosted cloud tier, evidence of offloading specific large open models (e.g. those in the local Hub) to cloud compute, automatic fallback when local hardware is insufficient, independent or hands-on corroboration.
